chunks: Those to whom We have sent down the Book, and who read it as it should be read, believe in it truly; but those who deny it will be losers.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for true belief in the Quran according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'haq qirā'atihi' (reciting it with its due right) is often interpreted as reciting the Quran with the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the true interpreters of the text. This verse underscores that mere possession of the Scripture is insufficient without correct understanding and adherence to its divine authority, a theme central to the Shia concept of Imamate as the living embodiment of the Book's meaning.
